response.sql: WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / m.geomdeltamm) AS r, COUNT(*) AS mesh_n FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_avg AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(r) AS a FROM site_ratio GROUP BY insurstat), kept AS (SELECT sr.zoneregistry, sr.insurstat, sr.r, sa.a FROM site_ratio sr JOIN status_avg sa ON sa.insurstat = sr.insurstat WHERE sr.r > sa.a) SELECT insurstat, AVG(r) AS avg_ratio_kept_sites, COUNT(*) AS kept_site_count, AVG(r - a) AS avg_excess_over_status_avg FROM kept GROUP BY insurstat

assumptions.assumption: A site's ratio is the average of facetresmm/geomdeltamm over its mesh records. Records where either value is NULL, or where geomdeltamm is 0 (SQLite returns NULL for division by zero), are ignored. The mesh-record count includes every matching record, though it is not part of the final output.
Sites with no mesh records are excluded by the inner join. Sites whose ratios are all missing have a NULL ratio, so they do not count toward the status average and cannot be kept.
Sites with a NULL insurstat are excluded. Empty-string statuses, if any exist, are treated as ordinary status values.
